mission.title: dapr: allow annotation to specify shutdown pause
mission.description: allow annotation to specify shutdown pause. Requested by 7+ users.

steps.title: Check current dapr deployment
steps.description:
Verify your dapr version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n dapr -l app.kubernetes.io/name=dapr
helm list -n dapr 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working dapr installation.

steps.title: Review dapr configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant dapr configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n dapr -l app.kubernetes.io/name=dapr
kubectl get configmap -n dapr -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=dapr
```
## In what area(s)?

## Describe the feature
We're struggling with making dapr lifecycle robust, especially during shutdown.

steps.title: Apply the fix for allow annotation to specify shutdown pause
steps.description:
I don't think `graceful-shutdown-seconds` covers the use case as described in the feature request as they are subtly but importantly different. Reoppening this issue as there are [requests](https://github.com/dapr/dapr/issues/7211) for it to be implemented.

I propose adding a `block-shutdown-seconds` option (default disabled) that will block the entire shutdown procedure until either 1. the app reports as unhealthy, or 2. the number of seconds has been reached on the block.

See the source issue for community-verified solutions.

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n dapr -l app.kubernetes.io/name=dapr
kubectl get events -n dapr --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "allow annotation to specify shutdown pause" is functioning correctly.
